resources.string: The song that\'s playing, with play, skip and like
A playlist you can scroll and play from
The music island round your camera
Lets LuvLyrics see which song another app is playing, so the island can play it here. It reads no notifications.

Shows the song that is playing in a small island round your camera, over every app. Tap it to open the player with play, pause, skip and a scrubber. Android only lets an accessibility service draw above the status bar, which is why it is here. It reads nothing on your screen and does nothing on its own.
